Will, 15 Nov 2026: "Tahama is absolutely NOT Semahara". They are 9.1 km apart in different wards - Tahama is ward 11 Tahama, Semahara is ward 02 Niniuri - and each carries its own footprint. place_aliases.csv had carried Tahama -> "Semahara Tahama" as an "inferred cluster, confidence 0.5", which is what made the Tahama-Toma leg measure 7.1 km instead of 12.7 km. That row is deleted. An inference at confidence 0.5 should never have been written as an alias in the first place.
